shortDescription: Manages Out-Of-Band controllers using Redfish APIs

options.name: account_properties
options.description: Properties of account service to update.

options.name: account_types
options.description: Array of account types to apply to a user account.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Security token for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: baseuri
options.description: Base URI of OOB controller.

options.name: bios_attributes
options.description: BIOS attributes that needs to be verified in the given server.

options.name: boot_next
options.description: BootNext target when bootdevice is "UefiBootNext".

options.name: boot_override_mode
options.description: Boot mode when using an override.

options.name: bootdevice
options.description: Boot device when setting boot configuration.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if O(validate_certs=true).

options.name: category
options.description: Category to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: ciphers
options.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with V(:). See the L(OpenSSL Cipher List Format,https://www.openssl.org/docs/manmaster/man1/openssl-ciphers.html#CIPHER-LIST-FORMAT) for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

options.name: command
options.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of account to delete/modify. Can also be used in account creation to work around vendor issues where the ID of the new user is required in the POST request.

options.name: new_password
options.description: New password of account to add/modify.

options.name: new_username
options.description: Username of account to add/delete/modify.

options.name: oem_account_types
options.description: Array of OEM account types to apply to a user account.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: reset_to_defaults_mode
options.description: Mode to apply when reseting to default.

options.name: resource_id
options.description: ID of the System, Manager or Chassis to modify.

options.name: roleid
options.description: Role of account to add/modify.

options.name: session_uri
options.description: URI of the session resource.

options.name: strip_etag_quotes
options.description: Removes surrounding quotes of etag used in C(If-Match) header of C(PATCH) requests. Only use this option to resolve bad vendor implementation where C(If-Match) only matches the unquoted etag string.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to OOB controller. The default value for this parameter changed from V(10) to V(60) in community.general 9.0.0.

options.name: uefi_target
options.description: UEFI boot target when bootdevice is "UefiTarget".

options.name: update_apply_time
options.description: Time when to apply the update.

options.name: update_creds
options.description: Credentials for retrieving the update image.

options.name: update_custom_oem_header
options.description: Optional OEM header, sent as separate form-data for the Multipart HTTP push update. The header shall start with "Oem" according to DMTF Redfish spec 12.6.2.2. For more details, see U(https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP0266_1.21.0.html). If set, then O(update_custom_oem_params) is required too.

options.name: update_custom_oem_mime_type
options.description: MIME Type for custom OEM properties for HTTP Multipart Push updates.

options.name: update_custom_oem_params
options.description: Custom OEM properties for HTTP Multipart Push updates. If set, then O(update_custom_oem_header) is required too. The properties are passed raw without any validation or conversion by Ansible. This means the content can be a file, a string, or any other data. If the content is a dictionary that should be converted to JSON, then the content must be converted to JSON before passing it to this module using the P(ansible.builtin.to_json#filter) filter.

options.name: update_handle
options.description: Handle to check the status of an update in progress.

options.name: update_image_file
options.description: Filename, with optional path, of the image for the update.

options.name: update_image_uri
options.description: URI of the image for the update.

options.name: update_oem_params
options.description: Properties for HTTP Multipart Push Updates.

options.name: update_protocol
options.description: Protocol for the update.

options.name: update_targets
options.description: List of target resource URIs to apply the update to.

options.name: update_username
options.description: New user name for updating account_username.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to V(true) to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with O(ca_path).

options.name: virtual_media
options.description: Options for VirtualMedia commands.

options.name: wait
options.description: Block until the service is ready again.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long to block until the service is ready again before giving up.
